text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's solutions and mistakes. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the codebase clean and consistent. Although reviews take extra effort, they are a valuable investment. Teams that review code carefully usually produce more reliable software and grow stronger together.
